51094-the-spy-the-story-of-a-superfluous.title: The Story of a Superfluous Man
51094-the-spy-the-story-of-a-superfluous.creator: Maxim Gorky
51094-the-spy-the-story-of-a-superfluous.description: A book by Maxim Gorky. Without winking his round eyes he looked forth upon the people from his retirement, cautiously contracted like a snail in its shell. When his eyes grew tired, he closed them, and for a long time sat sightless, gently swaying his thin body.

arxiv-2208-07590.title: Neural Networks for Extreme Quantile Regression with an Application to Forecasting of Flood Risk
arxiv-2208-07590.creator: Olivier C. Pasche, Sebastian Engelke
arxiv-2208-07590.description: Abstract Risk assessment for extreme events requires accurate estimation of high quantiles that go beyond the range of historical observations. When the risk depends on the values of observed predictors, regression techniques are used to interpolate in the predictor space.

Cohen, Nitya Kallivayalil, Rachel Beaton, Andrew A. Cole, Andrew Dolphin, Jason S. Kalirai, Karin M. Sandstrom, Alessandro Savino, Evan D. Skillman,
arxiv-2209-03348.description: Abstract We use globular cluster data from the Resolved Stellar Populations Early Release Science (ERS) program to validate the flux calibration for the Near Infrared Camera (NIRCam) on the James Webb Space Telescope ( JWST ). We find a significant flux offset between the eight short wavelength detectors, ranging from 1–23% ( ∼ \sim 0.01-0.

arxiv-2212-00154.title: Topological defect coarsening in quenched smectic-C films analyzed using artificial neural networks Preprint: August 9, 2026
arxiv-2212-00154.creator: Ravin A. Chowdhury, Adam A. S. Green, Cheol S. Park, Joseph E. Maclennan, Noel A. Clark
arxiv-2212-00154.description: Abstract Mechanically quenching a thin film of smectic-C liquid crystal results in the formation of a dense array of thousands of topological defects in the director field. The subsequent rapid coarsening of the film texture by the mutual annihilation of defects of opposite sign has been captured using high-speed, polarized light video microscopy.

arxiv-2402-05574.title: Quantum Amplitude Loading for Rainbow Options Pricing
arxiv-2402-05574.creator: Francesca Cibrario 1 , Or Samimi Golan 2 , Giacomo Ranieri 1 , Emanuele Dri 3 , Mattia Ippoliti 1 , Ron Cohen 2 , Christian Mattia 1 , Bartolomeo Montrucchio 3 , Amir Naveh 2 , and Davide Corbelletto 1
arxiv-2402-05574.description: Abstract This work introduces a novel approach to price rainbow options, a type of path-independent multi-asset derivatives, with quantum computers. Leveraging the Iterative Quantum Amplitude Estimation method, we present an end-to-end quantum circuit implementation, emphasizing efficiency by delaying the transition to price space. Moreover, we analyze two different amplitude loading techniques for handling exponential functions.

arxiv-2406-00502.title: Non-geodesically-convex optimization in the Wasserstein space
arxiv-2406-00502.creator: Hoang Phuc Hau Luu, Hanlin Yu, Bernardo Williams, Petrus Mikkola, Marcelo Hartmann, Kai Puolamäki, Arto Klami
arxiv-2406-00502.description: Abstract We study a class of optimization problems in the Wasserstein space (the space of probability measures) where the objective function is nonconvex along generalized geodesics. Specifically, the objective exhibits some difference-of-convex structure along these geodesics. The setting also encompasses sampling problems where the logarithm of the target distribution is difference-of-convex.

arxiv-2407-06215.title: Robust Routing and Scheduling of Home Healthcare Workers: A Nested Branch-and-Price Approach
arxiv-2407-06215.creator: Carolin Bauerhenne ⋆, Rainer Kolisch ⋄
arxiv-2407-06215.description: Abstract The global home healthcare market is growing rapidly due to aging populations, advancements in healthcare technology, and patient preference for home-based care. In this paper, we study the multi-day planning problem of simultaneously deciding patient acceptance, assignment, routing, and scheduling under uncertain travel and service times.

arxiv-2502-18681.title: Comparing Native and Non-native English Speakers’ Behaviors in Collaborative Writing through Visual Analytics
arxiv-2502-18681.creator: Yuexi Chen, Yimin Xiao, Kazi Tasnim Zinat, Naomi Yamashita, Ge Gao, Zhicheng Liu
arxiv-2502-18681.description: Abstract . Understanding collaborative writing dynamics between native speakers (NS) and non-native speakers (NNS) is critical for enhancing collaboration quality and team inclusivity. In this paper, we partnered with communication researchers to develop visual analytics solutions for comparing NS and NNS behaviors in 162 writing sessions across 27 teams.

pmc-11359564.title: Associations between Glyphosate Exposure and Glycemic Disorders: A Focus on the Modifying Effect of Sex Hormones
pmc-11359564.creator: Yu Dong, Yuan Li, Liwen Ma, Shuge Shu, Jiawen Ren, Xiangyu Yu, Dan Luo, Zhizhou Duan, Yongquan Yu
pmc-11359564.description: Widespread glyphosate contamination in the environment and its endocrine-disrupting potential are concerning. However, evidence of glyphosate’s effects on glycemic health is limited. To examine the association between glyphosate and glucose homeostasis in the general US population, a total of 3038 individuals were enrolled from the 2013-2016 cycles of the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES).

pmc-11610128.title: A model for predicting AKI after cardiopulmonary bypass surgery in Chinese patients with normal preoperative renal function
pmc-11610128.creator: Xuan Lin, Li Xiao, Weibin Lin, Dahui Wang, Kangqing Xu, Liting Kuang
pmc-11610128.description: ObjectiveTo develop and validate a predictive model for acute kidney injury (AKI) after cardiopulmonary bypass (CPB) surgery in Chinese patients with normal preoperative renal function.MethodFrom January 1, 2015, to September 1, 2022, a total of 1003 patients were included in the analysis as a development cohort.

pmc-11927549.title: Comparison of computed tomography–guided core needle biopsy of pulmonary nodules performed with and without the coaxial technique
pmc-11927549.creator: Qun-Qun Zhu, Li Zhang, Fengfei Xia, Yi‑Bing Shi, Lei Zhu, Xian‑Xian Liang
pmc-11927549.description: INTRODUCTION:Computed tomography (CT)-guided core needle biopsy (CNB) is a common method for diagnosing pulmonary nodules (PNs). It is often performed using the coaxial technique (CAT) to streamline the process.AIM:This study aimed to compare the safety and diagnostic performance of CT-guided CNB with and without CAT for diagnosing PNs.

pmc-12382053.title: Applying the three delays qualitative model to sepsis care seeking and emergency care in a private hospital in Lagos, Nigeria
pmc-12382053.creator: Abiola Fasina-Ayoola, Adebisi Adeyeye, Anna Tupetz, Francis Olajide, Abigail Obi, SimileOluwa Onabanjo, Akinboade Popoola, Oludoyinmola Ojifinni, Joao Vissoci, Catherine A. Staton
pmc-12382053.description: BackgroundSepsis remains a leading cause of death among hospitalized and critically ill patients in Nigeria. Despite progress in antimicrobial therapy access and emergency resuscitative care, it continues to account for a significant proportion of death and disability in low and middle-income countries and represents a significant burden of disease.

pmc-12588512.title: PfATP2 is a flippase on the Plasmodium falciparum surface that is important for growth and influences parasite sensitivity to antiplasmodial compounds
pmc-12588512.creator: Deyun Qiu, Eleanor England, Adele M. Lehane
pmc-12588512.description: Antimalarials play a crucial role in the fight against malaria. However, resistance of the most virulent malaria parasite, Plasmodium falciparum, to front-line antimalarials is spreading. To identify new antimalarials, millions of compounds have been screened for their ability to inhibit the growth of blood-stage P. falciparum parasites.

pmc-12651977.title: β-Sitosterol Enhances the Anticancer Efficacy of Oxaliplatin in COLO-205 Cells via Apoptosis and Suppression of VEGF-A, NF-κB-p65, and β-Catenin
pmc-12651977.creator: Sahar Khateeb, Fahad M Almutairi, Adel I Alalawy, Amnah Obidan, Mody Albalawi, Rehab Al-Massabi, Hanan Abdulrahman Sagini, Samah S Abuzahrah, Eman F S Taha, Anna Perri
pmc-12651977.description: Colon cancer (CC) is a common malignancy characterized by poor prognostic outcomes and considerable mortality. Oxaliplatin (OXP) is commonly used in the treatment of CC; however, its efficacy may be limited by side effects and the development of resistance. β-sitosterol (β-Sit), a phytosterol derived from plants, has been documented to be effective in the treatment of tumors.

pmc-12656891.title: HPV Vaccination in the U.S. Midwest: Barriers and Facilitators of Initiation and Completion in Adolescents and Young Adults
pmc-12656891.creator: Kristyne D Mansilla Dubon, Edward S Peters, Shinobu Watanabe-Galloway, Abraham Degarege, Christian Napoli
pmc-12656891.description: Background/Objectives: HPV vaccination uptake among adolescents and young adults in the US remains low, and coverage in the Midwest falls short of the Healthy People 2030 goal of 80%. Methods: A cross-sectional survey of adolescents and young adults was conducted to identify facilitators and barriers to HPV vaccination uptake among adolescents and young adults in the Midwest.

pmc-12750313.title: Impact of Intra‐fractional respiratory motion on dose distribution in lattice radiotherapy for liver tumors
pmc-12750313.creator: Kuo Li, Yong Yin, Tonghai Liu, Tianyuan Dai, Jian Zhu, Zhenjiang Li
pmc-12750313.description: PurposeTo quantify the detrimental impact of respiratory motion on the critical “peak‐and‐valley” dose distribution in lattice radiotherapy (LRT) for liver tumors, to thereby evaluate the necessity of motion management.MethodsThis study assessed the data of 24 patients with liver cancer who underwent free‐breathing 4D‐CT simulation, for which a 2×2×2 vertices LRT tree was constructed.

pmc-13380722.title: Calcitriol Suppresses Platelet Activation and Thrombosis, Mitigating Cardiovascular Risks in Metabolic Dysfunction–Associated Steatotic Liver Disease
pmc-13380722.creator: Peng Zhang, Huajie Xu, Shujing Wu, Wenxuan Zhou, Luning Zhou, Liping Han, Wei Zhang, Xiaoyu Lian, Xin Zhao, Haoxuan Zhong, Bing Fan, Hongyi Wu, Zhiyong Qi
pmc-13380722.description: Visual Abstract Vitamin D, a fat-soluble secosteroid hormone, primarily circulates in the bloodstream as 25-hydroxyvitamin D [25(OH)D] and exerts its biological functions in its active form, 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D3 [1,25(OH)2D3], also known as calcitriol.1 Although traditionally recognized for its role in bone and mineral metabolism, its potential impact on the cardiovascular system has been a subject of extensive investigation.

pmc-13508948.title: Development of a Colloidal Gold Immunochromatographic Test Strip for PPRV Antibody Detection Based on Antigenic Epitope-Derived Recombinant Protein
pmc-13508948.creator: Shenyuan Wang, Cong Han, Chuanhao Sun, Dong Zhang, Yongbin Liu
pmc-13508948.description: Simple SummaryPeste des petits ruminants is a deadly viral disease affecting sheep and goats, causing severe losses to farmers and threatening food supplies in many regions. Rapid and simple testing is essential for outbreak control and vaccination monitoring. In this study, we developed a test strip, similar to a pregnancy test, to detect antibodies against this virus in animal blood.

pmc-13553908.title: ADAPT-Net: an adaptive dynamic attention and persistence-aware transformer for overlapping community detection in complex social networks
pmc-13553908.creator: Gowthami Vusirikkayala, V. Madhu Viswanatham
pmc-13553908.description: Overlapping community detection in dynamic complex networks is challenging because memberships evolve over time, interactions arrive irregularly, and genuine bridge roles must be distinguished from noisy multi-community assignments. The aim of this study is to develop and evaluate adaptive dynamic attention and persistence-aware transformer (ADAPT-Net), an adaptive dynamic attention and persistence-aware transformer for overlapping community detection in complex social networks.
